description: Image Upload System - Install multer, create upload middleware and API endpoint, build drag-and-drop ImageUpload component, integrate into food listings with display in browse/detail views
steps: Install multer package in server directory: cd server && npm install multer
Create server/src/middleware/upload.js using multer with file storage to server/uploads/ directory, 5MB size limit, jpg/png/webp file type validation
Create server/uploads/ directory and configure Express in server/src/app.js to serve it as static files at /uploads route
Add POST /api/food/upload-image route in server/src/routes/foodRoutes.js that uses upload middleware and returns {imageUrl: '/uploads/filename.jpg'}
Create client/src/components/ui/ImageUpload.jsx - drag-and-drop component that posts to upload API, shows preview, handles loading/error states
Integrate ImageUpload component into client/src/pages/restaurant/CreateListing.jsx form, connect to image field in food listing creation
Update client/src/pages/public/BrowseFood.jsx to display food images in cards with fallback to placeholder gradient
Update client/src/pages/food/FoodDetail.jsx to show full-size food image with fallback placeholder
acceptance_criteria: Food listings can be created with uploaded images that persist in database
Image upload component shows drag-and-drop interface with preview functionality
Food browse page displays uploaded images in cards, or gradient placeholder if no image
Food detail page shows larger food image with proper fallback handling
File upload validates file types and size limits with appropriate error messages
verification: Test image upload API endpoint: curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/food/upload-image -F 'image=@test.jpg'
Create a food listing with an image upload and verify it appears in browse page
Test drag-and-drop functionality in CreateListing form
Verify images are served correctly at http://localhost:5000/uploads/[filename]
Test file validation with invalid file types and oversized files
